Assert that a value is a valid name_corrections argument

dot-lasa_assert_name_corrections.Rd

Shared validator for the name_corrections argument used by read_lasa_sav() and apply_lasa_labels(). A valid name_corrections is either NULL, or a named character vector mapping canonical LASA variable suffixes to the actual column names found in a user's data, for example c(lphya08 = "BLPYA08").

Usage

.lasa_assert_name_corrections(x)

Arguments

x

The value to check.

Value

Invisibly NULL. Called for its side effect of raising an error when x is neither NULL nor a validly named character vector.
